S098: Data Quality Officer reviews whether priority changes and their supporting rationale are recorded consistently for later assessment.

Answer "supported" only if the sentences state that Triage Supervisor produces or sends this item AND that Data Quality Officer receives or uses the same item (it may be named more briefly in one sentence). Return JSON {"verdict": ..., "reason": "one sentence"}.
